```{r}
rm(list=ls())
birds <- c('p004','p054','p138','p510','p530','p736')
sessions <- 1:180
#sessions <- 1:10
by_quarter <- NULL
by_session <- NULL
#qrtr_lims <- seq(20,60,20)
qrtr_lims <- seq(15,60,15)
qrt_str <- (qrtr_lims-15)*60
qrt_end <- qrtr_lims*60
for(bb in birds){
	for(ss in sessions){
		sess_dta <- read.csv(paste(c('../ConcurrentData/CSV files/',
			bb,
			's',sprintf('%02d',ss),
			'.csv'),collapse=''))
				med <- unique(sess_dta$med_notation_file)
				dynamic <- F
				if(length(unique(strsplit(med,split='_')[[1]][3:4]))==2){dynamic <- T}
				by_session <- rbind(by_session,
					data.frame(
						bird=bb,session=ss,
						dynamic_session=dynamic,
				#		quarter=qq,
				#		quarter_start=qrt_str[qq],
				#		quarter_end=qrt_end[qq],
						session_duration_sec=max(sess_dta$session_time_sec),
						resp_left=sum(sess_dta$event=='response_left_key'),
						resp_right=sum(sess_dta$event=='response_right_key'),
						reinf_left=sum(sess_dta$event=='feeder_on_left'),
						reinf_right=sum(sess_dta$event=='feeder_on_right')
						))
		for(qq in 1:length(qrtr_lims)){
		qrt_dta <- subset(sess_dta,
			session_time_sec>qrt_str[qq]&session_time_sec<=qrt_end[qq])
			if(nrow(qrt_dta)>0){
				by_quarter <- rbind(by_quarter,
					data.frame(
						bird=bb,session=ss,
						dynamic_session=dynamic,
						quarter=qq,
						quarter_start=qrt_str[qq],
						quarter_end=qrt_end[qq],
						session_duration_sec=max(sess_dta$session_time_sec),
						resp_left=sum(qrt_dta$event=='response_left_key'),
						resp_right=sum(qrt_dta$event=='response_right_key'),
						reinf_left=sum(qrt_dta$event=='feeder_on_left'),
						reinf_right=sum(qrt_dta$event=='feeder_on_right')
						))
			}
		}
	}
}
by_quarter$bird_num <- as.integer(factor(by_quarter$bird))
by_session$bird_num <- as.integer(factor(by_session$bird))
write.csv(by_quarter,file='pigeons_by_quarter.csv',row.names=F)
write.csv(by_session,file='pigeons_by_session.csv',row.names=F)
```
```{r,fig.width=6.5,fig.height=6.5,fig.align='center'}
plot(log(by_quarter$reinf_left/by_quarter$reinf_right),
	log(by_quarter$resp_left/by_quarter$resp_right),
	xlim=c(-6,6),ylim=c(-6,6),col=by_quarter$quarter)
abline(0,1,lty='22')
```
